name: Lucas Ferrenti
headline: Helping businesses book more sales appointments on autopilot with AI-Powered outreach | Growth Consultant @ Conversifi.io
summary:
At Conversifi, we help businesses automate their outbound prospecting and book more qualified sales appointments, without spending hours sending messages or replying to prospects.

Most sales teams lose opportunities because they can't keep up with manual outreach or respond quickly enough. Conversifi solves this by giving every user their own custom AI assistant that handles conversations for them, reaching out, replying in real time, overcoming objections, nurturing leads, and booking appointments directly into their calendar.

Our mission is simple: help businesses grow by replacing manual prospecting with intelligent automation that works 24/7.

We work with founders, sales teams, agencies, and consultants who want a predictable flow of booked meetings without hiring extra staff or managing complex tools.

Conversifi combines smart targeting, automated messaging, and advanced conversational AI to deliver consistent, high-quality appointments.

If you want to scale your outreach, increase conversions, and save time, Conversifi gives you the tools to make it happen, effortlessly.
